comment.body: Fixed in 610bdacd. Actual request-frame selection now trims the largest context frames first until the encoded payload is within the 24 MiB ceiling, preserving candidate evidence under the configured bounds. Evidence validation now records only candidate frames actually sent. Added a focused regression test; 50/50 team-scan and 86/86 pipeline-quality tests pass.
